decisions.reason: The award-winning high-pressure geothermal probe builds on the firm's tube, materials, and system-solution capabilities, giving management strong confidence that it can learn and improve it commercially.

The single-U geothermal probe is adjacent to existing materials and industrial application know-how and benefits from shared learning with the firm's other geothermal products, despite limited visible market proof so far.
The geothermal probe surface technology line fits the firm's materials and processing expertise, but as a more specialized multi-model offer it faces a somewhat higher portfolio-pruning risk.
The fire-protection steel profile system is very close to the firm's core building-systems and steel-profile knowledge base, so absorptive capacity for refinement and customer adaptation is high.
The slim steel profile system is a direct extension of established steel profile and customized construction capabilities, making it a natural product to retain.

The decorative steel profile surface system still relies on familiar profile and surface-finishing competences, although design-oriented niches are slightly more exposed to rationalization than functional core systems.
